about: Face types for people2 (art-source/tools/blender/people2/face_types.py, docs/people.md 'Faces in the game'). A person's face = type + slider values (shared/peopleSliders.json: shape keys of <body>_lod0 and <body>_lod1) + a face picture (cells: a layer of the face array) + hair, beard and moustache pieces (<body>_hair_<style>, <body>_beard_<style>, <body>_mous_<style>). face_for(seed, kind, sex, age) is the reference; 'rng' says how to repeat it; 'tests' are its outputs.

rng.pick: weights in key order (none as ''); r = uniform * total; first key where r - w < 0
rng.order: type (pick over the kind's types allowed for the sex: 'c' under 15, 'b' both); every slider in sliderOrder (face sliders: the type's sliders[name] else (0, defaultSpread); body sliders: the type's body[name] else (0, bodySpread[name]); origin_* and eye_fold 0 unless the type names them; bust 0 for men; value = mean + spread * gauss, clamped to -1..1 (0..1 one-way)); face_age set from the age (not drawn: (age-40)/35 clamped -0.6..1, -0.3 under 15); hair (children: plaits/crop, still one pick; else kindHair[kind] or the type's styles for the sex); the cell (floor(uniform * n) over the allowed cells: cellsFor); beard (men 18+), moustache (men 17+; a full beard forces walrus); the crook (uniform < chance, then its size uniform)

flemish_docker.desc: short wide skull, wide low face, square jaw, blunt chin, short broad nose with a round tip, small deep-set eyes, thick neck

fat_publican.desc: round skull, jowls that hide the jaw, a double chin, a small bulbous nose, puffy lids, a full lower lip

walloon.desc: oval face, narrow jaw, strong chin, high cheekbones, a heavy straight brow, a high bridge, thin lips

dutch_skipper.desc: long high skull, a long face and upper lip, a long narrow nose, flat cheeks, hooded eyes, big ears

scandinavian.desc: long narrow skull, a tall face, a high straight nose, the chin forward, deep-set eyes, ears that stand out

german_emigrant.desc: a very round skull with a flat back, a broad face, a short nose with a low root, wide-set eyes, a small chin

british_stoker.desc: a square face, a cleft chin, a snub nose, a wide mouth, big ears, ruddy and freckled

southern_sailor.desc: an oval face, a hooked nose with a high bridge, a heavy brow, large eyes, full lips, olive skin

levantine.desc: a long narrow face, a long high nose, prominent cheekbones, deep-set eyes, brown skin

african_sailor.desc: a rounded forehead, a broad nose with a low bridge, wide full lips, a strong jaw, dark skin

chinese_cook.desc: a round skull, a flat broad midface, a low nose root, a lid fold over a narrow opening, a shallow brow

pale_clerk.desc: a narrow face, a light jaw, a receding chin, a thin nose, large open eyes, a small mouth, flat ears

gentleman.desc: a long oval face, a high hooked nose, a firm chin, fleshy cheeks, heavy lids

gaunt_porter.desc: hollow cheeks, jutting jaw angles, deep sockets, a crooked nose, ears out, a big Adam's apple

round_flemish_woman.desc: a broad face with full cheeks, a soft jaw (nine tenths of a man's), a short upturned nose, full lips

lean_widow.desc: a long face, a long thin nose, flat cheeks, a pointed chin, large eyes, thin lips

young_woman.desc: a small oval face, high cheekbones, a small upturned nose, big wide-set eyes, a slim neck

southern_woman.desc: a strong straight nose, heavy brows, big dark eyes, full lips

small_child.desc: a big skull, the face three quarters of an adult's height, a button nose, lean working-class cheeks, a tiny chin, big ears

lanky_child.desc: ten to fourteen: the face lengthening, ears out, a thin neck, hollow cheeks if poor

shrunken_old.desc: no teeth: the chin nearer the nose, the lips rolled in; a drooping nose tip, long ears, hollow temples

heavy_old_man.desc: jowls, a bulbous veined nose, bags under the eyes, long ears, folds in the neck
